description: Global Electric 2 and 3 Wheeler Catalogue is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by UNEP. Two and three-wheelers are the fastest growing transport mode in many low and middle-income countries. While Asia has the lion’s share of the global motorcycle fleet, growth rates of motorcycles in many African countries are some of the highest in the world. Coverage: Benin. The portal files it under the publisher UNEP. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-06-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
